body:
## Code Review

This pull request introduces a script to map Method Map evidence availability to allowed diagnostic postures, along with associated tests and generated validation artifacts. The review feedback suggests stabilizing the sorting logic in `compareRows` by sorting lexicographically on `question_key`, validating the parsed input shape of `finalGate` to ensure robust fail-closed behavior, and expanding unit test coverage to explicitly test malformed input scenarios.
